# Glowboard

> Glowboard (https://glowboard.quantworlds.com) is a free, browser-based 2027 vision board wallpaper maker for iPhone and Android lock screens. Users pick 4–7 life goals, a word of the year, and an aesthetic look, optionally add their own photos (which stay on their device), and download a clock-safe lock screen collage in about 60 seconds with no sign-up.

- Free tier: 3 aesthetics (Clean Girl, Coquette, Old Money), iPhone (1179 × 2556 px), Android (1080 × 2400 px), Story (1080 × 1920 px), and 3:4 card PNG exports with a subtle watermark, January 2027 calendar lock screen, days 1–3 affirmation lock screens, 1 saved board slot, and free shareable friend board links.
- Pro tier (US$1.99 one-time payment via Gumroad, no subscription): all 18 aesthetics, Editorial Cover and 2027 Calendar layouts, signature stamps (11:11 Angel, Gold Wax Seal, 2027 Postmark), watermark-free exports, iPad, Desktop 4K, and printable A4 sizes, all 12 monthly 2027 calendar lock screens (.zip), 30 daily affirmation lock screens (.zip), matching blurred home screen wallpaper, printable A4 2027 goals checklist, unlimited saved boards, and a one-tap 2027 widget/wallpaper set (.zip).
- Privacy: static client-side web app with no accounts, no photo uploads, and cookieless GoatCounter analytics.
- Contact: qiny0015@gmail.com

Last updated: 2026-11-18
